entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-24
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Recommended approach for implementing cross-database querying in EF Core #36130
  • Neither AsSplitQuery (nor manual await calls) offer a way to run queries in parallel or in a single round trip batch #36132
  • How to customize `WebApplicationFactory` shared among different `ICollectionFixture`s? #36063
    Discussions

Updated

  • Consider allowing instantiation with non-parameterless constructor in queries, treating it the same as initializers #34562
    Backlog
  • The LINQ expression 'ProjectionBindingExpression: 0/1/2' could not be translated. #28125
    Backlog
  • LongCountAsync<TSource>(IQueryable<TSource>, Expression<Func<TSource,Boolean>>, CancellationToken) always return 1 even if there isn't any data in table #36125
  • JSON column path in JSON_VALUE does not respect [Column] or HasColumnName for owned JSON properties #36064
  • Temporal Tables: In SqlServerDatabaseModelFactory when revenging period column add IsPeriodStart/End annotation #36046
    Backlog
  • Constraint names we generate by convention don't check for duplicates with explicitly generated constraint names #36049
    Backlog
  • Primitive collections don't support ChangingAndChangedNotifications ChangeTrackingStrategy #36052
    Backlog
  • _migrationsAssemblyObject is missing from RelationalOptionsExtension copy constructor #36053
    10.0.0
  • NAOT; error when trying to run precompile queries step - "The build host could not be found" #36055
    10.0.0
